Remote Work and Team Output

Abstract
Teams that worked remotely closed 18% more tickets in a sample of 64 teams (n = 64).

Keywords: remote work, productivity

1. Introduction
Remote work grew quickly after 2020. We compare 64 teams over 6 months.
Output rose by 14% on average, and N = 60 teams completed the survey.

References
Lee, A. (2019). Remote teams. Journal of Work, 12(3), 45-67.
